body:
incidents-bot: ALERT: High rate of AUTH_FAILURE and unusual outbound requests detected from service-account 'ingest-proxy' :rotating_light:
incidents-bot: summary: ~18k 401s in last 10m, spikes to /internal/logs/export and /s3/copy endpoints, unusual user-agent 'crawler-thing/1.2'
Miguel Torres: paging @Aisha (oncall) — seeing same in tracing, 5 distinct source IP ranges, likely token misuse :eyes:
Aisha Patel: on it. quick ask: any customer reports yet?
Miguel Torres: no incoming CS tickets so far. logs show requests with header x-rw-origin: external-crawler
Aisha Patel: ok. immediate mitigation plan: 1) rotate ingest-proxy service token 2) block offending IP ranges at edge 3) suspend any temporary export jobs 4) run impacted-customer query and notify CS if needed
Samir Chen: +1. I'll take rotation and edge blocks. Miguel can run the customer impact query and prepare copy for CS/legal
Miguel Torres: running query now: `SELECT distinct(customer_id) FROM request_logs WHERE path LIKE '%/logs/export%' AND ts > now()-interval '30 minutes';` — returns 6 customer_ids (redacted)
Aisha Patel: copy that. Miguel, capture sample request ids and paths for forensics. Samir, add firewall rule and short iptables snippet to WAF 
Samir Chen: applied temporary WAF deny for 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.0/24 via edge ACL.  `edgectl acl add-deny --cidr 203.0.113.0/24 --reason "suspected token abuse"`
ops-bot: edgectl: deny rule applied (rule id: acl-deny-174200)
Samir Chen: rotating service token now. will call internal key-rotation endpoint.
Aisha Patel: post the rotation command you run in thread so we have an audit record
Samir Chen: running:
```
# rotate ingest-proxy service token
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  "https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/service-accounts/ingest-proxy/rotate-token" \
  -d '{"reason":"suspected leaked token - emergency rotate"}'
# invalidate old tokens in auth cache
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  "https://auth.internal/cache/invalidate?sa=ingest-proxy"
```
ops-bot: key rotation request accepted, job id kr-174200-01. will post status updates
ops-bot: kr-174200-01: step1 (issue new token) - SUCCESS
ops-bot: kr-174200-01: step2 (invalidate caches) - SUCCESS
Samir Chen: new token issued. deployed to ingest-proxy instances via hot swap. confirming no restarts required.
Aisha Patel: great. Miguel, what's the customer impact list?
Miguel Torres: customers potentially impacted (by id): [cust-824, cust-1130, cust-47, cust-662, cust-908, cust-301] — impact: possible exposure of export logs for last 2 hours. need CS/legal review for disclosure
Lena Park: I'll draft a cautious notification for affected customers. Legal (security-oncall) — any guidance?
security-oncall: please include: what happened, what we rotated (service account token), what we blocked (ip ranges), timeframe, and recommended customer actions (rotate customer-side keys if they used short-lived tokens). avoid speculation on root cause in customer message
Aisha Patel: agree. next steps: 1) hold short sync at :20 to coordinate CS + legal 2) run deeper forensic: S3 access logs and signer info 3) preserve affected instances and logs (snapshots + immutable archive)
Miguel Torres: running S3 access log extraction script now. snippet:
```
python tools/extract_s3_access.py --prefix logs/export --since "2025-10-12T14:00:00Z" --out /tmp/export-logs
```
Samir Chen: snapshotting ingest-proxy VMs and capturing container logs to /mnt/forensics; tags: incident-1742005432
Aisha Patel: good. also notify Dedicated customers page — may have inbound traffic routed differently. @ops-bot add a routing rule to prefer region-us-east for dedicated while we triage
ops-bot: routing rule change submitted (req 174200-route-1)
Miguel Torres: quick note — found requests using AWS STS AssumeRole with `sessionName` set to weird values. saving samples in forensic bucket
Aisha Patel: ok. we should rotate any long-lived keys exposed in those logs. who owns export-job-runner creds?
Samir Chen: export-job-runner creds are in secret-store path `prod/export-runner/creds`. rotating now: `secretctl rotate prod/export-runner/creds --reason "linked to incident 1742005432"`
ops-bot: secretctl: rotation started (job id sr-174200)
ops-bot: secretctl: rotation completed (job id sr-174200)
Aisha Patel: status check — service token rotated, WAF blocks applied, export-runner creds rotated, S3 logs extraction in progress, 6 customers flagged. Any signs of data exfil beyond GETs on /logs/export?
Miguel Torres: so far only GET/HEADs and ranged reads; no large DELETE operations. bandwidth pattern consistent with crawler-like activity but tied to auth header present — indicates token used to enumerate
Samir Chen: no new auth failures since rotation + blocks :thumbsup:
Aisha Patel: ok, put this to monitoring. keep blocking rules for next 24h unless we have evidence to relax. Samir, leave existing routing rule in place until further notice.
Miguel Torres: prepping notes for CS and legal. will attach sample request ids and timeline.
Lena Park: taking ownership of customer comms. ETA 40m draft, will share for review.
Aisha Patel: handoff: I need to step out in 25m. Samir, can you be primary until I return?
Samir Chen: I got it. I'll monitor page noise and escalate if anything changes.
Aisha Patel: thanks. also reminder — open a postmortem ticket and assign to eng-runtime + security for root cause and remediation. label as P2-security for now
Lena Park: noted — will include recommended CS templates and opt-in helpline for affected customers
incidents-bot: NOTE: Pager duty escalation to security-oncall at 1742005605
ops-bot: evidence bundle uploaded to forensics bucket (s3://forensics/incidents/1742005432/)
Miguel Torres: adding timeline section to notes: initial alert 1742005432, WAF blocks 1742005490, token rotate 1742005555, secret rotations completed 1742005620
Samir Chen: nothing else from my side. I'll keep monitoring and will escalate to infra if any new sign-ins from blocked CIDRs appear
Aisha Patel: good work team. we'll run the sync in 10m then handover. postmortem required.
Lena Park: creating incident ticket in tracker and adding stakeholders
security-oncall: will follow up on root cause. please avoid sharing raw logs outside forensics bucket; route all samples via forensics path
Aisha Patel: thanks all. keep thread updated with any anomalies or new customer reports. :white_check_mark:
